title.zh: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
title.en: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats

current_state.zh: Anthropic published a report claiming its Claude agent autonomously identified a previously undescribed CRISPR-like tandem repeat array near a known reverse transcriptase in raw genomic sequence, prompting an extensive Hacker News debate over the discovery's scientific novelty, the limits of AI biochemical reasoning, and the decision to publish as a corporate whitepaper rather than a peer-reviewed paper.
